newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to rule on PAI Bank insolvency in April.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to rule on PAI Bank insolvency in April.

text.p: The Sofia City Court is to rule on an insolvency case against Private Agricultural and Investment Bank (PAIB) filed by the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) at the beginning of April, a court official said.
"Defence lawyers for both sides are to submit their pleadings in writing in the next two days. The court should rule on the case up to seven days after that," the official told repoters.

PAIB is among the 15 local private and state banks against which the BNB has launched bankruptcy proceedings in two waves in May and October last year. Only one of them has been declared insolvent so far.
A ruling against state-owned Mineralbank is expected by end-March.
In March 1996 the BNB cancelled PAIB's licence on grounds of its negative capital to risk assets ratio, illiquidity, balance losses and systematic violations of banking regulations.

The bank had a 795 million lev loss as of January 31, 1996. It suffered a severe liqudity shortage and was unable to meet outstanding payments of 250 million levs and to provision its risks assets, the BNB said. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569; 981 4145
